manifest.name: dsh-lark
manifest.description: Run DeepSeek Harness sessions from Lark and Feishu chats

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:package

readme.text:
---
description: "Run local dsh tasks from Lark or Feishu and receive each task's answer in chat."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

[](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**Your local coding agent, a chat message away.**

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Send your Lark or Feishu bot a task. [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) runs it in your local workspace and replies to the message that started it. Review a change, investigate a failing test, or ask about your code while keeping the session available in the dsh Web UI.

- **Switch sessions.** Send `/sessions` in a private chat and click to continue a previous session.
- **Continue the conversation.** Private chats and group topics keep their own sessions; follow-up messages retain context.
- **Exchange files and track tasks.** Receive images/files, approve explicit file delivery, and follow one progress card with a stop button.
- **Stay in control.** Restrict senders and chats, inspect `/status`, interrupt with `/stop`, and start fresh with `/new`.
- **Use your existing dsh setup.** Sessions inherit the host's default agent preset and permission policy.
- **Keep setup local.** The bridge uses [lark-cli](https://github.com/larksuite/cli) event subscriptions; it opens no public webhook endpoint.
Example prompts: “Explain this repository's entry points”, “Review the changes in my workspace”, or “Find why the parser test fails”. Available actions depend on your dsh tools and permissions.

- [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Commands](#commands) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) -----

You need a working dsh installation, Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, pnpm, and a configured Lark or Feishu bot with `lark-cli` on your PATH. The current compatibility target is dsh `0.1.2-alpha.5`; see [setup](docs/setup.md) for credentials, scopes, and your sender ID.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark.git
cd dsh-lark
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

The local checkout is linked into the `web` profile. Rebuild it after changing source. If you run dsh from source, use `pnpm dsh` from the harness repository for the `dsh` commands; pass the absolute plugin directory to `add`.

Merge this entry into `${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, replacing the example sender ID. Keep any existing entries in that file.

```yaml
- id: lark
  config:
    allowedSenders: [ou_your_open_id]
    workspacePath: ~/projects/my-project

Session and interaction cards are enabled by default and require CLI `card.action.trigger` support. Configure callbacks using [setup](docs/setup.md) before starting; set `sessionCards: false`, `interactionCards: false`, and `progressCards: false` to disable all cards. Set `receiveAttachments: false` and `fileDelivery: false` for text-only use.

Start with direct messages. To enable groups, use `groupPolicy: mentions` and restrict `allowedChats`; see the [configuration reference](docs/configuration.md). An empty sender allowlist fails startup unless you explicitly enable `allowAllSenders`. The example uses English notices; set `locale: zh-CN` for Chinese.

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh web
```

The config dump should contain the `dsh-lark` layer and your settings; it does not check Lark connectivity. Send `/help` to your bot, then ask it to describe the workspace. Open the session in the Web UI to inspect tool activity. Handle permission requests and questions using the cards described in [interactions](docs/interactions.md).
To remove the bundle, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lark`. Saved dsh session history remains subject to your host's retention policy.

| Message | Result |
|---|---|
| Plain text | Run one task in this chat's session; additional tasks wait in a bounded queue. |
| `/sessions` | Show private-chat session choices; see [session switching](docs/sessions.md). |
| `/status` | Show the current session, running state, and queue without waiting for a task. |
| `/stop` | Cancel the current bridge task and clear pending messages. |
| `/new` | Cancel bridge work, clear pending messages, and reset this chat's session. |
| `/help` | Show available commands immediately. |

In groups, start a topic with the bot's exact `@display name`, then reply inside that owned topic to continue it. Unknown slash commands return help and never run as agent prompts. Bot notices support English and Simplified Chinese; the model chooses its answer language from the conversation. -----

<details>
<summary>Message flow and session ownership</summary>

`lark-cli` delivers message events → sender/chat checks admit them → a chat queue submits a dsh turn → the bridge selects that turn's recorded answer → `lark-cli` replies to its originating message.

The bundle's [patch](cordis.patch.yml) installs the `lark` row. The [service](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/blob/main/src/index.ts) owns the event consumer and [router](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/blob/main/src/bridge.ts); the host owns agents, tools, credentials, permissions, and durable session history. See [design](DESIGN.md) for concurrency, disposal, and delivery guarantees.

- [Setup](docs/setup.md) · [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) - [Security and data handling](SECURITY.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE) - [Private-chat session switching](docs/sessions.md) · [Approvals and questions](docs/interactions.md) - [Files, task progress, and group topics](docs/tasks.md) - [Personal and group examples](examples/)

Accepted input becomes a logged user message with its Lark chat, sender, message ID, and group topic root. Images use durable DSH attachment references; ordinary files become workspace locators. The bridge handles slash commands and registers the approved `lark_send_file` tool in its agents. A progress card projects logged assistant text without reasoning; the settled turn also receives a bounded text reply.

Text messages, plain-text replies, and private-chat session selection cards are supported. Send `/sessions`, then click **Switch to this session**; subsequent messages continue that session in the same bot chat. See [setup](docs/setup.md) for callback requirements. Approvals and structured user questions are supported in private chats and groups; see [interactions](docs/interactions.md). Images, ordinary files, explicit file delivery, and incremental text in task cards are supported; see [task workflows](docs/tasks.md). Ordinary file parsing depends on workspace tools, and image understanding depends on the selected model. Long answers are truncated; inspect the dsh session for the full response.

Chat sessions share the configured filesystem workspace and host permissions. Group members can see replies; authorized senders in the same topic share its context. Topic sessions still share the filesystem. Private-chat choices and the current selection survive restarts when session cards are enabled. Group bindings, queued messages, card tokens, and deduplication memory remain transient. This is a trusted-user integration, with no exactly-once delivery guarantee; review the [security model](SECURITY.md) before adding other users.

<details>
<summary>Working context for maintainers</summary>

None.

</details>

---
description: "从飞书或 Lark 启动本机 dsh 任务，并在聊天中收到每个任务的回答。"
kind: "package-bundle"
---

[](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**发条消息，让本机编程助手开始工作。**

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

向飞书或 Lark 机器人发送任务，[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 就会在本机工作区中执行，并回复触发任务的那条消息。你可以审查改动、排查测试失败，或询问代码；会话也会保留在 dsh Web UI 中，方便继续查看。

- **会话切换。** 私聊发送 `/sessions`，点按钮继续历史会话。
- **连续对话。** 私聊与群话题各自保留会话，追问时保留上下文。
- **收发文件与跟踪任务。** 接收图片和文件，审批明确的文件交付，并在进度卡片中查看任务、点击停止。
- **随时掌控。** 限制发送者和聊天，用 `/status` 查看状态，用 `/stop` 停止，用 `/new` 重新开始。
- **沿用 dsh 配置。** 会话使用宿主的默认 agent preset 和权限策略。
- **本地接入。** 桥接通过 [lark-cli](https://github.com/larksuite/cli) 订阅事件，无需开放公网 webhook 接口。
可以试试：“解释这个仓库的入口”“审查工作区里的改动”或“找出 parser 测试失败的原因”。具体可执行的操作取决于 dsh 的工具和权限。
- [使用](#use-this-package) - [命令](#commands) - [实现概览](#understand-the-implementation) - [继续阅读](#further-exploration) - [模型体验](#model-experience) - [已知限制与待办](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) -----
你需要能够正常运行的 dsh、Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`、pnpm，以及已配置的飞书或 Lark 机器人；`lark-cli` 需要在 PATH 中。当前兼容目标为 dsh `0.1.2-alpha.5`；凭据、权限与发送者 ID 的准备见[安装指南](docs/setup.zh-CN.md)。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark.git
cd dsh-lark
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

本地目录会链接到 `web` profile；修改源码后需要重新构建。如果从源码运行 dsh，请在 harness 仓库中用 `pnpm dsh` 执行下文的 `dsh` 命令，并给 `add` 传入插件目录的绝对路径。

把下面的配置合并到 `${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`，将示例发送者 ID 换成自己的 ID，并保留文件中已有的其他配置。

```yaml
- id: lark
  config:
    allowedSenders: [ou_your_open_id]
    workspacePath: ~/projects/my-project

默认启用会话与交互卡片，CLI 必须提供 `card.action.trigger`；启动前按[安装指南](docs/setup.zh-CN.md)配置回调。关闭全部卡片时设置 `sessionCards: false`、`interactionCards: false` 和 `progressCards: false`。仅需文本时另设 `receiveAttachments: false` 与 `fileDelivery: false`。
先从私聊开始。群聊请使用 `groupPolicy: mentions`，并限制 `allowedChats`，详见[配置参考](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md)。发送者白名单为空时启动会失败，除非显式启用 `allowAllSenders`。示例使用英文提示，中文请设为 `locale: zh-CN`。

```sh dsh --profile web --dump-config dsh web ``` 配置输出应包含 `dsh-lark` 层和你的设置；这一步不检查飞书连接。向机器人发送 `/help`，再请它介绍工作区。在 Web UI 打开对应会话，可以查看工具执行情况；审批和询问通过[交互卡片](docs/interactions.zh-CN.md)处理。 卸载使用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lark`。已经保存的 dsh 会话历史仍由宿主的保留策略管理。

| 消息 | 结果 | |---|---| | 普通文本 | 在当前聊天的会话中执行一个任务；后续任务进入有长度限制的队列。 | | `/sessions` | 在私聊中展示会话选择卡片；操作方法见[会话切换](docs/sessions.zh-CN.md)。 | | `/status` | 立即查看当前会话、运行状态与队列，无需等待任务完成。 | | `/stop` | 取消桥接的当前任务并清空待处理消息。 | | `/new` | 取消桥接任务、清空队列并重置当前聊天的会话。 | | `/help` | 立即显示可用命令。 | 群聊以机器人的准确 `@显示名` 发起话题，随后在该话题中回复即可继续。未知斜杠命令会返回帮助，不会作为 agent 提示词执行。机器人状态提示支持英文和简体中文；模型根据对话选择回答语言。 -----

消息处理与会话归属 `lark-cli` 提供消息事件 → 检查发送者与聊天权限 → 聊天队列提交 dsh 回合 → 桥接提取该回合记录的回答 → `lark-cli` 回复触发消息。 组合包的 [patch](cordis.patch.yml) 安装 `lark` 行。[服务](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/blob/main/src/index.ts) 管理事件消费者与[路由器](https://github.com/ChengqianHuang/dsh-lark/blob/main/src/bridge.ts)；宿主管理 agent、工具、凭据、权限和持久会话历史。并发、卸载与投递保证见[设计说明](DESIGN.zh-CN.md)。

- [安装指南](docs/setup.zh-CN.md) · [配置参考](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md) · [故障排查](docs/troubleshooting.zh-CN.md) - [安全与数据处理](SECURITY.zh-CN.md) · [参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) - [私聊会话切换](docs/sessions.zh-CN.md) · [审批与询问](docs/interactions.zh-CN.md) - [文件、任务进度与群话题](docs/tasks.zh-CN.md) - [个人与群聊配置示例](examples/)
通过检查的输入会作为用户消息写入日志，并附带飞书聊天、发送者、消息 ID 和群话题根消息。图片使用 DSH 持久附件引用，普通文件形成工作区位置记录。桥接处理斜杠命令，并在所属 agent 中注册需审批的 `lark_send_file` 工具。进度卡片展示已记录的 assistant 文本，不展示推理；回合结束后另发受长度上限约束的文本回复。

支持文本消息、纯文本回复和私聊会话选择卡片。发送 `/sessions` 后点击“切换到此会话”，后续消息会在同一机器人聊天中继续所选会话；回调配置见[配置机器人](docs/setup.zh-CN.md)。私聊与群聊支持审批和结构化询问，见[交互指南](docs/interactions.zh-CN.md)。支持图片、普通文件、明确的文件交付与任务卡片中的增量文本，见[任务流程](docs/tasks.zh-CN.md)。普通文件解析取决于工作区工具，图片理解取决于所选模型。长回答会被截断；完整内容请查看 dsh 会话。 各聊天的会话共用配置的文件系统工作区和宿主权限。群成员可以看到回复，同一话题中的已授权发送者共享上下文；不同话题仍共用文件系统。启用会话卡片时，私聊历史选项和当前选择跨重启保留；群聊绑定、待处理消息、卡片交互标识和去重记录不保留。这是面向可信用户的集成，不保证消息恰好投递一次；添加其他用户前请阅读[安全模型](SECURITY.zh-CN.md)。

<details>
<summary>维护者工作背景</summary>

无。

</details>
